case.title: Manslaughter & Wounding with Intent
case.other:
At about 01:00 a.m. on Wednesday 22 August 2001, a 22-year-old Chinese male TSOI Ping-hung (Deceased) and his friend TSOI Wing-lok (Victim, aged 28 at the time of offence) were attacked by unknown person(s) with sharp weapons at G/F, Yick Cheong Building, 1046 King’s Road, Quarry Bay while they were inside a light refreshment restaurant.

They managed to escape but were later found lying outside the shop. The deceased was conveyed to the hospital with bruises on his neck and was certified dead on the same day. The victim suffered from several stab wounds and was subsequently treated and discharged from the hospital.

Photograph of the Deceased is shown at left.

Any member of the public who has information related to the crime or information about the identity or whereabouts of the culprit(s) shall contact Police without delay.

A reward of four hundred thousand Hong Kong dollars ($400,000-HK) is being offered by Police.

The reward will be paid, either in full or pro-rata, to a member of the public, or apportioned amongst members of the public, giving information within the period specified in this notice leading to the arrest and satisfactory prosecution of the culprit(s). For the purpose of the reward, “satisfactory prosecution” shall mean that the arrested person(s) is/are found to have a case to answer in cases in Magistrates’ Courts, District Court or Court of First Instance of the High Court of Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

case.title: Murder
case.other:
At about 6:30 a.m. on Tuesday 17 December 2002, the body of a 41-year-old Marine Services Section manageress HO Mo-ling was found lying dead in a pool of blood covered by black garbage bags at her office on 1/F, Administrative Block, Royal Hong Kong Yacht Club, Kellett Island, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong. There were signs of struggle at the scene. The deceased's handbag, a platinum wedding ring engraved with 'Harman 8.9.91', a wrist watch, a black wallet, a HK Identity Card, three bank cards and a grey upper coat were found missing.

The left and right part of her head had been injured by a blunt object. The cause of death was a stab wound on her neck. The deceased was last seen outside the Administrative Block of the Club at 6:45 p.m. on 16 December 2002 and the estimated time of death was about 10p.m. on the same night. It is believed she was attacked in the interval.

Photograph of the deceased is shown at left.
